policy: common-sense validators only; no taste policing; no unregistered validator in release pipeline

validators.purpose: Prevent broken GitHub Actions YAML and unsafe workflow drift.
Prevent off-strategy release drift.
Ensure cumulative master-plan deliverables exist and route families match the lock.
Ensure validation pipeline remains registered, matrixed, and common-sense.
Ensure clean URL canonical policy and prevent clean-to-html redirect loops.
Prevent generated authority pages from flattening into repository root.
Ensure 0-6 month priority pages exist and route to WPP.
Ensure homepage CTAs route beginning, middle, and end to WPP.
Ensure disavow and earned citation ledgers exist.
Ensure strategy-gated release plan has existing non-blocked units.
Ensure insights are published deterministically with no active draft queue leakage.
Ensure answer cards have required JSON and HTML surfaces.
Ensure entity coverage remains present for LLM surfaces.
Prevent broken internal links.
Ensure every canonical HTML page appears in sitemap.
Ensure pages carry source/citation fanout block.
Ensure every programmatic page is built from governed atoms.
Ensure page families have route, atom, schema, CTA, and noindex rules.
Prevent unadmitted programmatic routes and duplicate query-target releases.
Ensure public atlas contains the 6-month query universe.

Refuse to publish a query atlas entry that carries no demand evidence in a named unit. Distinct from `query-atlas`, which validates the public HTML atlas built from data/query_atlas/query_universe.json.

Enforce the demand-unit contract: no row may carry the ambiguous `volume` key, a GSC row may not claim a search_volume without keyword-tool provenance, demand_basis must agree with the populated fields, rank_score must be banded, and no source file may read the removed field off a query row.
Ensure canonical autonomous release contracts and registries exist.
Ensure collector→normalizer→score→release→content proof artifacts exist.
Ensure 6-month route/query target matches approved citation strategy.
Ensure $0 mode forbids paid providers by default.
Ensure controlled cadence caps and release contract.
Ensure GSC-first and $0 intelligence contract.
Ensure agent/artifact intake lane exists even when GSC is primary.
validators.repair_rationale: The validator fails with the literal message "missing normalized agent-run artifact packet; run citation:normalize-artifacts". normalize_agent_run_artifacts.js is the only writer of data/agent_runs/normalized_agent_runs.json. The validator names its own repair.

validators.purpose: Ensure normalized artifact schema exists.
validators.repair_rationale: The validator rejects data/agent_runs/normalized_agent_runs.json when records[] or mode is absent. That packet has exactly one producer, normalize_agent_run_artifacts.js, so regenerating it is the only thing that can fix a malformed packet.

validators.purpose: Ensure intake/cutover compatibility map exists.
Ensure release plan units obey caps and schema.
Ensure release writes proof artifacts.
Ensure admitted routes are tracked and non-duplicate.
Ensure generated content is governed by atoms and page families.
Ensure generated pages are not thin placeholder pages.
validators.repair_command: npm run content:quality:report && npm run release:quality:self-heal
validators.repair_rationale: The programmatic-substance check reads data/content/programmatic_quality_report.json and fails on a missing report or on a changed /programmatic/ route flagged thin/exact_duplicate/near_duplicate - the same report and the same flag set the repair regenerates and quarantines. It also fails on "release page missing after apply", which the quarantine resolves by removing the unit from the plan, summary and distribution trace together.

validators.purpose: Ensure clean canonical URLs and no redirect loops.
Ensure pages have title, description, canonical.
validators.repair_command: npm run repairs:diagnose && npm run repairs:apply
validators.repair_rationale: The validator fails a page missing <title>, meta description, or rel=canonical. diagnose_pages.js emits exactly those defects as AUTO findings (missing_meta_description, meta_description_length, missing_canonical, duplicate_title) and apply_repairs.js writes those three tags on the diagnosed routes. The npm wrapper is used rather than the raw script deliberately: apply_repairs.js thaws routes via data/release/active_mutation_scope.json and the wrapper carries the required validate -> freeze -> clear-scope refreeze sequence.

validators.purpose: Ensure sitemap includes key canonical routes.
Prevent unsafe/guaranteed SEO claims.
Ensure strategy remains WPP / virtual-event scope.
Ensure lockfile-based deterministic build.
Block secrets/runtime cache artifacts.
Validate release plan, content trace, page release law, generated content gate, and programmatic substance.
Validate seven-pillar authority, entity and autonomy contracts.
Validate truthful static admin and allowlisted operations.
Validate no-op, reconciliation and mismatch semantics.
Trace workflow scenarios without live execution.
Validate canonical artifact requirements in packaged shape.
Ensure all applicable Repo Work OS Pass 13.1 capabilities and operator artifacts are present.
Ensure aggressive 90-day full-flow settings, seven pillars, and citation truth rules remain active.
Ensure changed programmatic routes meet minimum substance and duplicate-suppression gates while legacy quality debt remains explicitly reported.
validators.repair_command: npm run content:quality:report && npm run release:quality:self-heal
validators.repair_rationale: validate_programmatic_quality.js fails in exactly two ways: the quality report is stale (it prints "run npm run content:quality:report"), or a route released this cycle carries thin/exact_duplicate/near_duplicate. content:quality:report regenerates that report; self_heal_release_quality.js quarantines pages carrying that identical three-flag BLOCKING set and reverts them to HEAD. Same defect, same flag set.

validators.purpose: Ensure artifact manifest workflow inventory and archived receipt references match the repository tree.
Ensure no published page renders external-agent build directives (FILEPATH:/CURRENT:/MISSING:/EDIT:, citation-ready update text) as reader-facing copy.
Ensure no published page ships a table with empty <td>/<th> cells that break column-to-header alignment for answer engines.

Report pre-publish coverage of the blocks the external review agent repeatedly asks for (direct answer, h1 phrasing, populated tables, one conversion path, checklist, comparison table, concrete numbers, named sources, FAQ, JSON-LD). Reporting severity while 143 pages carry no direct-answer block; promote to HARD_FAIL at zero.

Stop the audience-permutation fan-out regrowing. Rule A: every route in the class (777 today) that is indexable must carry measured demand or GSC impressions - the 714 with neither ship noindex. Rule B: no ungoverned "for <x>" suffix may exceed 60 indexable evidence-free routes without being gated under Rule A.
Prevent a working repair lane from being orphaned: every self-heal npm script must be reachable from a workflow.
Keep main validated on commits push-triggered CI cannot see: GITHUB_TOKEN pushes from bot lanes do not trigger workflows.

repair_policy: repair_command is only declared where the repair targets the same defect the validator detects. Adding one so a failure disappears is forbidden; an unrepairable failure must stay unrepairable and be reported by name.
